tree.treeLabel: Accessible label of the list of collections and requests.
tree.topLevel: Name of the root position when moving an item: outside any folder.
tree.copy: Context menu item for requests and folders.
tree.cut: Context menu item. Cut and then paste moves an item.
tree.duplicate: Context menu item that makes a copy next to the original.
tree.moved: {{name}} is the name of the item that was moved. Shown as a notice with an Undo button.
tree.movedMany: Notice after moving several items at once.
tree.pasted: Notice after pasting. {{name}} is the pasted item.
tree.duplicated: Notice after duplicating. {{name}} is the new item.
tree.moveTitle: Title of the dialog that asks for a destination folder. {{name}} is the item being moved.
tree.emptyImport: Button in the empty state that opens the import dialog.
tree.unreadableTitle: Title of a warning: some files in the opened folder could not be parsed.
tree.unreadableAction: Button that lists the problem files.
tree.emptyFolder: Shown inside a folder that has no requests.
tree.editLabels: Context menu item. Colour means the colour label of a folder.
tree.select: Context menu item that starts selecting several items.
tree.selectedCount: Number of selected items in the selection bar.
tree.selectionBar: Accessible label of the bar with actions for the selected items.
tree.dragCount: Text next to the pointer while several items are dragged.
tree.deleteManyMessage: {{subject}} is a list such as "2 requests and 1 folder".
tree.deleteManyMessageFolders: Same, shown when folders are included. Items inside a deleted folder that are not selected stay in the collection.
tree.requestCount: Used inside the delete confirmation to name how many requests will be deleted.
tree.folderCount: Used inside the delete confirmation to name how many folders will be deleted.
tree.moreTags: Badge for tags that do not fit in the row, for example +3.
label.colour: Label of the colour choice for a folder icon.
label.tags: Tags are short free-text labels on requests and folders.
label.tagColour: Accessible label of a colour swatch. {{tag}} is the tag text.
label.removeTag: Accessible label of the button that removes a tag. {{tag}} is the tag text.
tab.close: Context menu item that closes one tab.
tab.keepOpen: A preview tab is replaced by the next request you open. This turns it into a normal tab.
tab.revealInTree: Context menu item that scrolls the sidebar to the request of this tab.
tab.copyAsCurl: Keep cURL as written; it is a command line tool name.
tab.previewHint: Tooltip of a preview tab (shown in italics).
tab.closeTabsMessage: The singular form is used when exactly one of the tabs has unsaved changes. The plural form starts with the number.
tab.discard: Confirm button that closes tabs and throws away unsaved edits.
tree.editTags: Menu item that opens the tag editor for a request or folder.
label.done: Button that finishes editing a label. Verb.
tab.closeRight: Tab menu item. Closes the tabs after this one in tab order. In right-to-left languages those tabs sit on the visual left, so translate the meaning ("after this tab"), not the word "right".
tab.moveLeft: Tab menu item. Moves the tab one place toward the visual left of the tab bar, in every language direction. Translate as a physical direction.
tab.moveRight: Tab menu item. Moves the tab one place toward the visual right of the tab bar, in every language direction. Translate as a physical direction.
